tei:div.tei:p: "!#༈: rigs 'dus rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bdag 'dra rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs sems can 'gro la brtse phyir du: kun rdzob ma yin don dam 'bras bu can: thams cad 'dus pa'i rigs 'dus rdo rje sems: padma 'byung gnas gsang ltar sgrub pa'i thabs: snying khrag thigs pa srog gi dwangs ma bshad: bsgom bsgrub byas na 'ja' lus chos sku thob: nyams su longs shig rjes 'jug bu slob rnams: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: dkyil 'khor gtor ma gang yang mi 'tshal te: rang lus lhar bskyed ka dag gtor ma bsham: dran rtog rang grol spyan 'dren bzhugs phyag 'tshal: bstod bya bstod byed bral ba'i ngang la gzhag: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas ni: rang rig ma 'gags dkyil 'khor 'di ltar bsgom: oṃ swa bhā ba sogs: hrī: chos rnams thams cad stong pa'i ngang nyid las: rang sems ma 'gags sprul pa'i rig rtsal gyi: sna tshogs snang ba'i cho 'phrul ci yang shar: ye nas rnam dag kun gzhi'i dkyil 'khor gsal: dharma dhā tu dzñā na swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: stong pa'i ngang las 'ja' 'od gzhal yas khang: phyi nang zang thal sgrib med gsal ba'i dbus: rin chen khri rkang padma nyi zla'i steng: ma bcos rang byung hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las: rang rig skad cig bla ma rdo rje sems: sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin: g.yon pas dngul gyi dril bu dku la bsten: rang 'od yum 'khyud dar dang rin chen brgyan: rdo rje skyil krung 'dzum bcas sang nger bzhugs: 'ja' 'od zer gsum lu gu rgyud du 'bar: spyi bor rnam snang 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin: dpral bar 'khrugs med rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: mgrin par mtha' yas padma dril bu 'dzin: snying gar lhun grub rdo rje thod pa 'dzin: lte bar rin 'byung rin chen dril bu 'dzin: gsang bar don grub rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: dkar mthing dmar smug ser ljang kha dog ldan:

kun kyang dar dang rin chen sna tshogs brgyan: rang 'od yum 'khyud rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: gzhan yang rang lus rtsa gnas thams cad du: rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: til gyi gang bu kha phyes lta bur gyur: thugs kar dwangs ma lnga ldan 'od lnga'i klong: rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams 'khor bcas gsal: dpral mgrin thugs kar oṃ āḥhūm̐ yig las: 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems: rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs gnyis med thim: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru badzra dzñā na satwa hūm̐: oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐: badzra sa ma ya dza dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: skye med rnam dag chos dbyings zhing khams nas: 'gyur med bla ma rigs 'dus rdo rje sems: bdag gis dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: ma 'gags gsal stong lhun grub zhing khams nas: rgyal ba rigs lnga rigs kyi yum dang bcas: bdag gis dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: bde chen bde spyod dag pa'i zhing khams nas: padma thod phreng zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs: bdag gis dad pas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: 'dir bshams padma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: bla ma chen po'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig ye shes chu la chu bzhag tshul: gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du bzhugs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru badzra dzñā na satwa hūm̐: sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: ye nas rnam dag lhun grub 'dus ma byas: bde chen rol pa'i khyab bdal sgyu ma'i gar: rang snang ma 'gags gzhan snang der ston pa'i: rdor sems rigs lnga'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya a ti pū ho: pra ti dza ho: hūm̐: chags med ye shes chen po'i ngo bo la: 'dod dang sred pa zhes bya'i ming yang med: bdag sogs 'gro kun bsod nams rdzogs phyir du: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes: gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos rnam pa drug: gzhan nas ma byung rang sems rig pa'i mdangs: rang rig rang gsal dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul:

blang dang dor med ro gcig ngang du bzhes: arghaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai widyā shabda pū dza ho:rū pa shabda gandhe ra sa sparshe pū dza ho: hūm̐: kun khyab rang snang chos dbyings pho brang nas: ma 'gags gsal stong thugs rje'i nyi ma shar: chags med nyon mongs 'joms pa'i tsha zer rgyas: kun bzang chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zag med bde ba chen po'i rol pa las: ngo mtshar sgyu ma lta bu'i 'ja' tshon shar: 'od gsal ngo bo nyid kyi thig les brgyan: kun bzang longs spyod rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ye shes lnga yi 'od klong dag pa'i mkha': 'gyur med rdo rje lta bu'i gzugs sku grub: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin: kun bzang sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i khri steng du: bla ma chen po rdo rje sems dpa' ni: dkar gsal mdangs ldan sku gsum 'dus pa'i dpal: thabs shes dbyer med rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen brgyan: rdo rje skyil krung dgyes pa'i gar gyis bzhugs: rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo 'khril stabs rol: dkyil 'khor gtso mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bla ma chen po rdo rje sems dpa' yi: sku yi gnas lngar rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: rtsa gnas thams cad rdo rje sems dpas khengs: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od du 'bar: 'ja' 'od zer gsum snang srid rab 'byams khyab: sprul bsgyur gar gyis 'khor ba dong nas sprug: chos dbyings ngang la bde chen 'du 'bral med: zhi khro rab 'byams kun 'dus khyod la bstod: ho: thams cad mkhyen gzigs ye shes ngo bo la: mi shes mi mthong zer ba'i ming yang med: spyan lnga 'chang ba'i lha rnams dgongs su gsol: bdag ni ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag rnams: rang gnong 'gyod sems drag pos mthol lo bshags:

chos dbyings rnam dag ngang du bzod par gsol: tshangs dbang mchog gi dngos grub dus 'dir stsol: hūm̐: rang nyid bla mar gsal ba'i thugs ka ru: ye shes sems dpa' smug nag zhal gcig pa: phyag gnyis rdo rje g.yas la thod pa g.yon: 'gying bag tshul gyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: de yi thugs kar rdo rje nas 'bras tsam: lte bar zla gdan hūm̐ yig dngul gyi mdog: ba spus bris pa lta bus gsal bar mtshan: de yi mtha' mar sngags phreng bskor ba las: 'od zer dkar po phyogs mtha' khyab par 'phros: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi: sdig sgrib nyes ltung ma lus kun byang ste: rdo rje sems dpa'i sku ru gsal bar gyur: slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas: phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud sems can lha: sgra grags sngags gsal dran rtog ting 'dzin ngang: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru badzra dzñā na satwa hūm̐: zhes rtsa ba'i sngags dang: oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐: snying po dang: āoṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: gsang ba'i snying po dang: oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya: zhes sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod do: de ltar bsgom zhing rtsa sngags khri phrag gsum: snying po bye ba gsang snying stong rtsa gsum: yi ge brgya pa skabs dang bstun te bzla: rtags ni rang nyid mkha' la 'phur ba dang: gos dkar gyon zhing zam pa chen po brgal: lus nas khrag gam rnag sogs 'byung ba dang: rtswa dang sog ma nags ri bsregs pa sogs: de rnams rmis na 'grub pa'i rtags yin pas: bskal pa stong nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib kyang: ma dag gyur na padmas phyi rabs bslus: khyer so gsum gyi ngang la bzhag pa gnad: thun bsdu'i dus na phyi snod rang la bstim: rang nyid hūm̐ gyur thig le'i bar du bsdu: thig le dbyings dang bsre zhing spros med bzhag: cir yang ma grub rang sems rig pa'i mdangs: gang shar ngo bo lta zhing rang thog 'jog: bsgom med ye shes gnyug ma'i bya ra bya:

skye 'gags gnas gsum bral ba'i ngang la bzhag: 'dis ni tshe gcig sangs rgyas ma thob kyang: bar dor mngon sangs rgya bar the tshom med: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: bka' 'di chos skyong shel phreng can gyis srungs: su ma tri rā dza sa ma ya rakṣa rakṣa: slob dpon chen po'i gsung ltar bdag 'dra nam mkha'i snying pos bsam yas mchims phur bkod pa'o/// / phyi snod gzhal yas rang lus lha la thim: rang nyid hūm̐ gyur thig le'i bar du bsdu: thig le dbyings dang 'dres shing spros pa bral: cir yang ma grub rang sems rig pa'i mdangs: gang shar ngo bo bltas shing rang thog 'jog: bsgom med yengs med gnyug ma'i bya ra bya: skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba'i ngang du bzhag: dge 'dis padma 'byung gnas rdo rje sems// bdag gis tshe 'dir go 'phang mchog thob nas// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kyi// sa la dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog / ces rdo rje sems dpa'i bsdu rim 'di rdo rje drag pos brjod pa'o/// / 1$0000250༁ྃཿ yang zab 'pho pa'i gdams ngag 'ja' zer chos sku myur 'grub bzhugs so: 1$0000300na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: ma 'ongs 'gro ba thams cad kyi: sdig chen gshin po'i don ched du: tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs: zab lam 'pho ba'i gdams ngag bstan: de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las: dang po rdor sems cho gar 'bad: dngos gzhi 'pho ba'i gdams ngag bstan: rjes su skye med ngang la bzhag: de la'ang dam ldan dge slong gis: rang rgyud dag par smin byas la: gshin po'i ro 'am byang bu'i mdun: rigs drug yul bkod so sor dang: gu ru drug gi sku gzugs bsham: bgegs gtor khrus bum rdor dril dang: mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad bsham: byang sems ldan zhing snying rjer bsgom:

rig pa ngar 'don lta stangs bya: dbyangs snyan rol mo'i sgra yis bskul: rus pa tshe 'das dngos su bsgom: bden med ngang du 'di skad do: hūm̐: rang rig bla ma rdo rje sems: dag pa sku gsum ngang la gnas: ma dag dngos 'dzin mtshan ma bral: ye nas rdo rje 'gyur med gsal: rang mdun padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus: 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad steng: nṛ yig sngon po'i 'phro 'du las: dmigs yul tshe 'das gson po'i tshul: phung khams skye mched yongs su rdzogs: bden med me long gzugs brnyan ltar: stong gsal ngang du gnas par gyur: de nas bden stobs brjod pa ni: dza: bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum: mkha' 'gro chos skyong bden pa yis: tshe 'das rnam shes gar gnas kyang: skad cig nyid du 'dir khug cig: hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥnṛ dzaḥṭā ki hūm̐ dza: dmigs pa ni: rang nyid bla mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas: dzaḥyig dmar po 'phros pas rnam shes ngo bo nṛ sngon po bkug nas gzugs la bstim: de nas bgegs gtor mar me ting lo changs bu phung po la bskor zhing: oṃ sarba bighnān: na maḥsarba ta thā ga te sogs: hūm̐: tshe las 'das pa'i sa lam bgegs: mchod sbyin glud gtor 'di khyer la: gshin po 'di la gegs ma byed: phyogs med phyogs kyi gnas su dengs: hūm̐: rang rig bla ma'i thugs ka nas: yi ge hūm̐ chen mthing nag 'phros: snang srid thams cad khro bos gang: mtshon cha me dpung glog ltar 'khyug: bka' 'das dam log 'byung po rnams: rdul phran bzhin du brlags nas kyang: bgegs dang log 'dren ming yang med: mtshams las ma 'da' bgegs kyi tshogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te badzra kī li kī la ya: sarba bighnān mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ: de nas rol mo bsgrag: gu gul bdug: yungs dkar gyis brab la gtor ma phyi rol du dor: de nas bum pa'i khrus chu rus pa la dor zhing sdig sgrib sbyong ba ni:

hūm̐: nyon cig dmigs yul tshe 'das nyon: nga ni bla ma rdo rje sems: sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i dpal du shar: thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngon po'i mthar: yi ge brgya pa g.yas su 'khor: de nyid 'od zhu bdud rtsi dkar: tshe 'das khyod kyi spyi bor bab: spyi gtsug rkang mthil lus rnams gang: sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags kun: sprin las chu bur rdol ba ltar: shel sgong lta bur dag nas kyang: sgrib med 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru badzra dzñā na satwa hūm̐: oṃ badzra satwa hūm̐: zhes pa'i mthar yi ge brgya pa dang: sarba pā paṃ kaṃ ka ni bi sho dha ya ā ba ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā: zhes brjod cing bkru'o: hūm̐: chos dbyings ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu: dug lnga'i sgrib pa rnam par dag: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: dug lnga'i sgrib pa dag gyur cig: gong ltar sngags rnams brjod: hūm̐: me long ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu: zhe sdang sgrib pa rnam par dag: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: zhe sdang sgrib pa dag gyur cig: gong ltar dang: hūm̐: mnyam nyid ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu: gti mug sgrib pa rnam par dag: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol= gti mug sgrib pa dag gyur= hūm̐: sor rtog ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu: 'dod chags sgrib pa rnam par dag: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol= 'dod chags sgrib pa dag gyur= hūm̐: bya grub ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu: phrag dog sgrib pa rnam par dag: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol= phrag dog sgrib pa dag gyur= hūm̐: ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i chu: nga rgyal sgrib pa rnam par dag: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol= nga rgyal sgrib pa dag gyur= hūm̐: pha rol phyin drug bdud rtsi'i chu: bag chags rnam drug rnam par dag: tshe 'das khyod la khrus gsol bas: bag chags rnam drug dag gyur cig: ces sngags dang: de nas rdo rje thogs la: hūm̐: rkang gnyis gtso bo 'dren pa'i mchog:

sangs rgyas dkon mchog bden pa yis: nyon mongs dug gsum zhi gyur nas: 'bras bu sku gsum mngon gyur cig: hūm̐: chags med ye shes mkhyen pa'i bdag: dam chos dkon mchog bden pa yis: nyon mongs dug gsum zhi gyur nas: 'bras bu sku gsum mngon gyur cig: hūm̐: bsod nams tshogs zhing sprul pa'i sku: dge 'dun dkon mchog bden pa yis: nyon mongs dug gsum zhi gyur nas: 'bras bu sku gsum mngon gyur cig: de nas 'byung ba lnga yi mtshan ma thogs la: hūm̐: sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams: rkyen dang rgyu yi rang bzhin las: gzung 'dzin bag chags rab tu 'thas: ye nas rdzogs pa'i bden pa yis: rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'khor ba'i gzhi: 'khor ba'i 'khor lo zhig gyur nas: skye med dbyings su rang sar dag: sdug bsngal thams cad zhi gyur cig: ces rtsa sngags dang snying po yig brgya sham bu btags pa bzla zhing sdig sgrib thams cad yi ge kaṃ nag por gyur nas khrus chu'i nang du thim par bsam zhing chu bo'i gzhung du dor: de nas dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro lha min mi dang lha yi yul ljongs re dang: gu ru rnam gnon rnam snang siṃ ha rab brtan rnam rgyal pad 'byung srid thub kyi sku gzugs rnams kyang so sor bzhag la: de nas gu ru rnam gnon thogs la:

hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rkang mthil nag gsal thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: dmyal ba'i gu ru smug nag rnam par gnon: zhe sdang dmyal ba'i yul ljongs zad par byed: tshe 'das rnam shes du yig nag po ni: zhe sdang dmyal ba'i gnas nas hūm̐ gis drangs: tsha grang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes brjod pas dmyal ba'i yul nas drangs te yi ge pre gcig tu gyur par bsam: dmyal ba'i ling tshe bsgyur la: yi dwags gu ru rnam snang thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gsang gnas ser gsal thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: yi dwags gu ru ser gsal rnam snang byed: ser sna yi dwags yul ljongs zad par byed: tshe 'das rnam shes pre yig ser po ni: ser sna yi dwags yul nas hūm̐ gis drangs: bkres skom yi dwags sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes brjod pas yi dwags yul nas drangs te yi ge tri sngon po zhig tu gyur par bsam la yi dwags ling tshe bsgyur: de nas gu ru sing ha rab brtan thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: lte ba sngo ljang thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: byol song gu ru seng ge rab brtan mthing: byol song glen lkug yul ljongs zad par byed: tshe 'das rnam shes tri yig sngon po ni: byol song glen lkug yul nas hūm̐ gis drangs: gcig za glen lkug sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes brjod pas dud 'gro'i yul nas drangs te yi ge su ljang gu zhig tu gyur par bsam la byol song gi ling tshe bsgyur: de nas rnam rgyal thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snying ga ljang gsal thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: lha min gu ru ljang nag rnam par rgyal: phrag dog lha min yul ljongs zad par byed: tshe 'das rnam shes su yig ljang gu ni: 'thab rtsod lha min yul nas hūm̐ gis drangs: 'thab rtsod phrag dog sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes brjod nas lha min yul nas drangs te nṛ yig sna tshogs zhig tu gyur

par bsam la lha min ling tshe bsgyur: de nas pad 'byung thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mgrin pa sna tshogs thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: mi yi gu ru pad 'byung dkar dmar zhal: 'dod chags mi yi yul ljongs zad par byed: tshe 'das rnam shes nṛ yig sna tshogs ni: 'dod chags mi yi yul nas hūm̐ gis drangs: skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes brjod mi yi yul nas drangs te a dkar po zhig tu gyur par bsam la ling tshe bsgyur: de nas srid thub thogs la: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: klad pa dkar gsal thig le'i dkyil 'khor du: lha yi gu ru dkar gsal srid thub 'dzin: pham ltung lha yi yul ljongs zad par byed: tshe 'das rnam shes a yig dkar po ni: pham ltung lha yi yul nas hūm̐ gis drangs: nga rgyal pham ltung sdug bsngal zhi gyur cig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes brjod pas lha yi gnas nas drangs par bsam la yi ge hrīḥdakar dmar gcig tu gyur nas snying padma 'dab brgyad la gnas par bsam la: lha yi ling tshe bsgyur: de ni rigs drug gnas 'dren te: rigs drug las thar pa'i gnas kyi 'pho ba'o: gnyis pa gcig car gyi 'pho ba ni: tshe 'das dngos su bsam la skyabs su 'gro ba dang gsol ba 'debs pa dmigs pa bstan pa dang gsum mo: dang po la gnyis te: skyabs yul bsgom pa dang skyabs su 'gro ba'o: gnyis pa la gsum ste: gsol ba 'debs pa: bshags pa bya ba: smon lam btab pa dang gsum mo: dang po skyabs yul bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: dmigs yul rigs kyi bu khyod kyi: mdun gyi nam mkha' yangs pa ru: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: dkon mchog gsum dang zhi khro'i lha: rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus kun: sprin phung 'thibs pa ji bzhin du: skad cig nyid la gshegs par gyur: hūm̐: dmigs yul tshe 'das khyod nyon cig: skye ba snga ma bor nas su: da lta bar do yid kyi lus: sha khrag phung po bral nas ni:

'chi ba bar dor 'khyams shing gnas: dbang po kun tshang thogs med rgyu: rten med bya sgro rlung bskyod ltar: bsam pa tsam gyis gling bzhi 'grim: nyam nga yid mug za zi'i ngang: nges med gang la'ang ltos pa med: 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab: dngos med yid lus yin pa'i phyir: rjes dang grib ma gzugs brnyan med: zag bcas mngon shes yod pa'i phyir: gzhan sems rgyu ba bzang ngan shes: yid kyi snang brnyan sgyu ma ltar: bden med byis pa 'ja' ded 'dra: bsags pa'i nor rdzas shul du lus: 'grogs pa'i nye 'brel rnams dang bral: rnam smin grib ma bzhin du 'grog: 'dus byas me tog lta bur yal: gshin rje'i pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: da dung rang sems zhal ma mthong: de yi dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams: da khyod skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas: lus kyis phyag 'tshal gus pa gyis: ngag gis skyabs 'gro dag pa gyis: yid kyis gdung shugs drag po gyis: ma yengs rtse gcig ngang la sdod: mdun gyi skyabs yul thams cad la: skyabs su 'gro ba'i lad mo gyis: 'di'i skabs su ngo sprod gang shes bya: skyabs su 'gro ba ni: e ma ho: dgongs su gsol lo gsan du gsol: skyabs gsum ngo bo dkon mchog gsum: mi phyed dad pas skyabs su mchi: gdung shugs drag pos 'o dod 'bod: bar do 'jigs pa'i 'phrang lam nas: dmigs yul tshe 'das bskyab tu gsol: sku gsum lhun grub kun tu bzang: mi phyed dad pas sogs: bla ma chen po rdo rje 'chang: mi phyed= rigs kun rdo rje sems dpa' la: mi phyed= bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga la: mi phyed= rgyal ba shākya thub pa la: mi phyed= phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas la: mi phyed= zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis la: mi phyed= 'bar ba lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la: mi phyed= nyan rang byang sems khro bo la: mi phyed= rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs la: mi phyed= bskal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad la: mi phyed=

skyabs su mchi 'o bskyab tu gsol: 'jigs las myur du bskyab tu gsol: bar do longs sku thob par mdzod: dmigs yul tshe 'das thugs rjes zungs: zhes brjod la skyabs su 'gro bar bya'o: skabs 'dir 'pho ba'i mtshams sbyor bya: de nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni: hūm̐: dmigs yul rigs kyi bu khyod nyon: tshe 'di'i snang ba nub nas ni: phyi ma'i snang ba ma shar te: srid pa bar ma do ru gnas: 'dus byas tshe 'di'i 'dun gros la: ma chags ma 'dzin shol la thongs: gal te zhen chags 'dzin na ni: sdug bsngal dpag med myong bar 'gyur: de bas dad pa'i shugs kyis su: rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams la: gsol ba thob la rig pa gtod: e ma ho: rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings pho brang nas: 'gyur med bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen la: dad mos gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs: lam myur zab mo 'pho ba 'byong ba dang: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma shes dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams pa yis: sdug bsngal thar med mya ngan g.yang sar lhungs: zhen chags ther zug lus ngan phung pos 'ching: mi gtsang 'dam rdzab nyon mongs gnas khang nas: rang rig brjod med stong gsal ngo bo 'di: mi ldog dag pa bde chen zhing khams su: snang mtha' yas pa'i thugs kar 'pho bar shog: ྈ chos nyid klong yangs chen po'i pho brang nas: chos sku kun bzang yab yum 'khor bcas la: ྈ dad mos gdung shugs drag pos sogs: rnam dag 'od lnga thig le'i dkyil 'khor nas: longs sku rigs lnga yab yum 'khor bcas la: ྈ dad mos sogs: gsal 'tsher 'od dkar khyab pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' la: ྈ dad mos sogs: gang la gang 'dul ston pa'i zhing khams su: gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs la: ྈ dad mos sogs: phyogs bcu mu med rab 'byams zhing khams su: dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad la: ྈ dad mos sogs: nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su:

chos sku snang ba mtha' yas 'khor bcas la: ྈ dad mos sogs: gdul bya 'gro don mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: longs sku thugs rje chen po 'khor bcas la: ྈ dad mos sogs: rnga yab dpal ri 'od kyi gzhal yas nas: sprul sku padma 'byung gnas 'khor bcas la: ྈ dad mos sogs : hūm̐ hrī: ka dag spros zhi'i gnas mchog dam pa nas: bde gshegs rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma la: ྈ dad mos sogs: snang stong rol rtsed dag pa'i pho brang nas: rang byung rig 'dzin brda' brgyud bla ma la: ྈ dad mos sogs: mtha' yas 'gro don mdzad pa'i pho brang nas: dag gtsang gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma la: ྈ dad mos sogs: thugs rje rgyun chad med pa'i pho brang nas: mchog gsum bka' lung brgyud pa'i bla ma la: ྈ dad mos sogs: brtse chen ldan pa'i 'gro 'dul zhing khams nas: drin chen rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma la: ྈ dad mos sogs: zhi khro gar ston rol pa'i zhing khams su: yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs la: ྈ dad mos sogs: phrin las mthar phyin mdzad pa'i zhing khams su: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can 'khor bcas la: ྈ dad mos sogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ston mchog dam pa sangs rgyas rin po che: 'dren pa mnyam med dam chos rin po che: dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun rin po che: bla na med pa bde ba chen po'i sku: dkon mchog gsum dang byang sems nyan rang la: ྈ dad mos gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs: lam myur zab mo 'pho ba 'byong ba dang: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: ma shes dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams pa yis: sdug bsngal thar med mya ngan g.yang sar lhungs: zhen chags ther zug lus ngan phung pos 'ching: mi gtsang 'dam rdzab nyon mongs gnas khang nas: rang rig brjod med stong gsal ngo bo 'di: mi ldog dag pa bde chen zhing khams su: snang mtha' yas pa'i thugs kar 'pho bar shog: ces gsol ba gdab bo: bshags pa bya ba dang smon lam gdab pa ni:
